welcomeDescription: Manage your account and sign in to a H.A.V.E Terminal securely, wherever you are.
loginDescription: Welcome back. Use your phone number and four-digit PIN.
signupDescription: Use your name in English. Verify your phone and email to finish creating your account.
smsDescription: Enter the six-digit code sent to your phone.
emailDescription: Enter the six-digit code sent to your email. Your account is not created until this step is complete.
expired: This request has expired. Start again to get a new code.
restartDescription: A new code restarts registration. You must verify your phone and email again. Re-enter your PIN before sending the new code.
accountCreated: Your account is ready. Please sign in.
pinReset: Your PIN has been changed. Please sign in again.
recoveryDescription: If an eligible account matches this phone, we will send an SMS code. After resetting your PIN, sign in again.
dashboardDescription: Your account is ready. Choose where you want to go.
terminalLoginDescription: Scan a Terminal QR to sign in securely.
scanDescription: Generate a QR from the Terminal sign-in screen, then scan it here. Review the Terminal before approving.
approveWarning: Only approve if you are physically using this Terminal. Approval lets this Terminal access your account.
cameraSecure: Camera scanning needs HTTPS or localhost. Open the trusted HTTPS address on your phone.
cameraDenied: Camera access was denied. Allow camera permission in your browser settings and try again.
cameraUnavailable: No usable camera was found. Close other camera apps and try again.
qrProblem: Unable to read or check this QR. It may be invalid, expired or unavailable. Try again.
restoreFailed: Could not restore your session. Check your connection and sign in again.
logoutFailed: You are signed out on this screen, but server-side sign-out was not confirmed. Reconnect and sign in, then sign out to confirm it.

qrStatus.approved: Approved. Waiting for the Terminal to finish signing in…
qrStatus.completed: The Terminal is now signed in.

validation.name: Use English letters, spaces, apostrophes or hyphens (up to 32 characters).
validation.email: Enter a valid email address (up to 128 characters).
validation.dob: Enter a valid date as DD/MM/YYYY, not in the future.

errors.credentials: These credentials were not accepted, or the session has ended. Please try again.
errors.conflict: This request conflicts with an existing account or expired action. Check your details and start again.
errors.limited: Too many attempts. Wait before trying again.
errors.invalid: Check the entered details or verification code. The code may have expired.
errors.network: The service could not be reached or is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
errors.field: Check this field and try again.
